result.title: Solver-Admitted Metamorphic Testing of Learned Network Optimization Surrogates
result.summary: Equivalent encodings of an optimization problem can produce different learned predictions. Interpreting these differences requires accounting for numerical error and multiple optima. We construct metamorphic tests for optimization solver surrogates with explicit eligibility conditions, output alignment, and numerical thresholds. Reference-solver agreement and independent constraint checks determine which sampled pairs enter the audit. We study alternating-current optimal power flow (AC-OPF), the traveling salesman problem (TSP), the capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP), and maximum independent set (MIS). Across five grids, GridSFM-Open violates each of 13 relations on at least one grid, and 12 by more than twice the threshold. Randomly initialized copies of the grid models fail nearly the same relations, so the failures do not require training. Source patches and input canonicalization remove selected discrepancies, but no intervention establishes preserved accuracy and feasibility within the declared margin on every grid. In routing, Policy Optimization with Multiple Optima (POMO) has a single-pass rotation/reflection violation rate that rises from 12.7% to 89.5% between 20 and 100 cities. Graph-Based Diffusion Solvers for Combinatorial Optimization (DIFUSCO) violates the MIS disjoint-union relation on 35.6% of draws. Post hoc normalization within connected components removes these violations on the tested graphs. These findings support reporting metamorphic consistency alongside optimality, feasibility, and accuracy, and validating repair quality separately from consistency.

AI.brief_summary: 论文为学习型优化求解器替代模型构造蜕变测试，用参考求解器一致性与独立约束检查筛选样本，并在 AC-OPF、TSP、CVRP、MIS 上量化等价编码下预测不一致的程度及各类修补手段的效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「等价输入变换下输出应保持一致」的审计协议可能可供核查 LVR 内部状态是否保留任务必要信息，并把一致性修补与准确性、可行性评估分开，但需迁移到视觉推理场景。
